title: A central executor keeps its own query-log spool and the follower writes its row too, and the job is counted once
goal: A server executor writes one ops row per finished job, carrying the job id and origin server, to its own query-log spool and delivers it to the integration remote as a clone does (never the publish remote); kbjob.py follow writes the same row with origin follower in the submitter's clone; kbjob.py stats and the digest count each job id once, preferring the executor's row; a CI job writes none

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
o=os.path.join(d,"o.git"); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q","--bare","--local",".",o],check=True)
qa=os.path.join(d,"qa"); qb=os.path.join(d,"qb")
ea=dict(env,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=qa,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd()); eb=dict(env,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=qb,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd())
H.out=dec(executor="server")
j=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","backlog-check","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA,"--clone-url","file://"+o).stdout)["job"]
kj("serve","--kind","server","--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--once",e=ea); kj("follow",j,e=eb)
st=json.loads(kj("stats","--format","json","--home",qa,"--home",qb).stdout)
assert st["check"]["n"]==1, st
